youtube.title: What's the toothpaste color code really for? #shorts
youtube.description:
What does the square on toothpaste mean? It's not a toothpaste color code for what's inside: green doesn't mean natural and black doesn't mean chemicals. It's called an eye mark. At the factory the end of the tube starts out open, and a light sensor watches each tube go by. When the coloured square reaches the beam, the machine knows exactly where to seal and cut the end. It's a dotted line for the machine, not a message for you.
